item.title: Booking Approval: You Choose Who Gets In
item.description:
Booking Approval: You Choose Who Gets In

Not every event is first-come, first-served. Sometimes you need to check skill level, verify membership, or simply make sure the right people are in the room. That’s why we’ve launched Booking Approval — a simple way for organisers to review and approve attendees before their spot is confirmed.

Players tap Request to Book instead of Book Now. You review each request in your Organiser Hub. And here’s the part that matters most: their payment method is not charged unless you accept them.

Why Organisers Love It

Booking Approval puts you back in control without adding friction to your workflow:

  • Curate your crowd — approve the right mix of players for competitive sessions, members-only events, or skill-based groups
  • No awkward refunds — since cards aren’t charged until you approve, you won’t need to refund players you turn away
  • A fair window to decide — you have 48 hours to review each request before it’s automatically declined
  • Works with forms — review a player’s form responses before you hit approve

What Players Experience

From the player’s side, the flow is straightforward and transparent:

  1. They select tickets and click Request to Book
  2. They see a clear message: “Organiser approval required. Your card won’t be charged until you’re approved.”
  3. After checkout, they get a confirmation that their request was submitted
  4. You approve or reject — and they’re emailed either way

If approved, their card is charged and they receive a booking confirmation. If rejected, the hold on their card is released and the spot goes back on sale.

How to Turn It On

Booking Approval is available on paid events with Stripe connected. Enable it when creating an event, or toggle it anytime from your event’s Settings tab.

Once enabled, head to Organiser Hub → your event → Attendees to review pending requests. You’ll see Pending, Approved, and Rejected tabs — approve or reject with a single click.

Try It Out

Running a session where you want to hand-pick participants? Enable Booking Approval in your event settings and take control of who joins.

Built with ❤️ by the SPORTSHUB team.

item.title: Event Attendees on Event Page: See Who's Going Before You Book
item.description:
Event Attendees on Event Page: See Who’s Going Before You Book

Ever been on the fence about attending an event, then noticed a friend’s name on the list and thought “alright, I’m in”? That’s the power of social proof — and now it’s built right into SPORTSHUB.

We’ve just shipped a new feature that lets organisers display a “Who’s going” section directly on their public event page. Players can see who else has signed up before they book, making it easier to commit and more fun to plan around.

Why This Matters

Social proof is one of the strongest motivators when it comes to event attendance. Knowing that other people — especially people you recognise — are going to an event makes a huge difference. It turns a “maybe” into a “definitely”.

For organisers, this means real impact:

  • Higher conversion rates — players who land on your event page are more likely to book when they see others have already committed. Fewer abandoned carts, more filled spots.
  • Community building — attendees start to recognise regulars, fostering a sense of belonging even before the event starts. Your events become destinations, not just dates on a calendar.
  • Momentum — early sign-ups encourage more sign-ups. It’s a positive feedback loop that helps new events gain traction faster.

Privacy First

We know attendee data is sensitive, so we’ve been intentional about what’s shown and what isn’t.

  • Only full names are displayed. No email addresses, no phone numbers, no ticket types, no payment information — nothing else.
  • Opt-out by default. The feature is off until an organiser explicitly turns it on.
  • Organisers have full control. You can toggle the setting on or off at any time, and the change takes effect immediately.

The backend enforces this too — if the feature is disabled, the attendee list endpoint returns nothing, regardless of how the page is accessed.

Try It Out

If you’re an organiser on SPORTSHUB, enable it in your event settings — it takes seconds and could be the nudge your next attendee needs to book.

And if you’re a player, keep an eye out for the “Who’s going” section next time you’re browsing events — you might just spot a familiar name.

Have feedback on this feature? We’d love to hear from you. Reach out to us through the Contact Us page.

item.title: [Feature] Custom Event Links
item.description:
Introducing Custom Event Links 🔗

We’re excited to announce our latest feature that’s going to make sharing your events easier than ever! Say hello to Custom Event Links - your new best friend for seamless event promotion.

What are Custom Event Links?

Custom Event Links allow you to create a permanent, branded URL on SPORTSHUB that you can share anywhere - social media, emails, business cards, you name it! The best part? These links are smart - they automatically update to point to your latest event in your recurring event series.

How it Works

⭐ For Single Events

Create a custom link like sportshub.net.au/event/username/your-brand that points directly to your event. Perfect for one-off tournaments, recurring workshops, or special events.

🗓️ For Recurring Events

Set up a custom link that automatically updates to your next recurring event. No more broken links or manual updates - your link stays fresh and always points to the current event in your series.

Why You’ll Love It

  • 🎯 Brand Consistency: Keep your links clean and professional
  • ⚡ Always Current: Links automatically update for recurring events
  • 📱 Share Anywhere: Works on all platforms and devices
  • 🔄 Zero Maintenance: Set it once, forget about it

Perfect For

  • Sports Clubs running weekly sessions
  • Event Organizers with regular tournaments
  • Anyone who wants a professional, permanent event link

Getting Started

Head over to your organiser dashboard and look for the “Custom Links” section. Create your first custom link in just a few clicks!

Ready to make your events easier to share? Try Custom Event Links today!

Built with ❤️  by the SPORTSHUB team.
